description: This file defines utility functions for creating and handling string enums and channel target schemas using the @sinclair/typebox library. It facilitates flexible schema definitions with optional descriptions and specific enums, tailored for use in a schema-driven validation or API specification context.

methods.name: export function stringEnum<T extends readonly string[]>( stringEnum
methods.description: Creates a string enum schema with optional description and title, utilizing Type.Unsafe for flexible enum representation.

methods.name: export function optionalStringEnum<T extends readonly string[]>( optionalStringEnum
methods.description: Wraps stringEnum to make the enum optional in the schema.

methods.name: export function channelTargetSchema(options?: { description?: string }) { channelTargetSchema
methods.description: Defines a schema for a single channel target string, with customizable description.

methods.name: export function channelTargetsSchema(options?: { description?: string }) { channelTargetsSchema
methods.description: Defines a schema for an array of channel target strings, with customizable description.
